correctness.rationale: Theorem 3.4 of arXiv:2308.11427 and Proposition 5.3 of arXiv:2409.02939 supply the linearly independent normal coordinates \(x_1^{d-1}x_j\). For a generator matrix F the relations vanish iff \(\varepsilon_m F=c\varepsilon_n\): nonzero F has a nonzero target column, forcing all augmentation column sums equal. In degree \(d\) the map is \(c^{d-1}F\). Idempotence gives \(c^2=c\), \(B^2=B\), and \(Bu=(1-c)u\); images follow by PBW independence (square-zero when \(c=0\), \(A_r\) when \(c=1\)). The shear action removes u and GL(H) conjugates projections by rank. Counting image/kernel complement pairs produces Gaussian times \(q^{r(n-r)}\). All hypotheses, boundary ranks and characteristics are explicit. The extracted checker directly evaluates the actual defining relations and \(M^2=M\) over six finite prime-field cases and four rectangular cases; these are cross-checks, not infinite proofs.

originality.rationale: A full-text claim comparison shows the 2023/2024 canonical-PBW papers establish the defining algebra and certain Veronese/Segre morphisms but no classification of all degree-preserving algebra homomorphisms, their composition-idempotent members, image types, automorphism-conjugacy classes or complete finite-field rank spectrum. The earlier 2022 full text concerns Yang–Baxter solution and semigroup structures, not this exact operator invariant. published-finding corpus searches for source, presentation, aliases and retract spectra returned different objects rather than an implied stronger result. Residual undiscovered equivalences are noted.
residual_risks: Equivalent graded map descriptions in older literature on rank-one product or idealization algebras might not use Yang–Baxter keywords and could imply the theorem.

The 2023 main and 2024 extension give a strong PBW normal form, so the linear-map calculation is elementary once that structure is recognized; originality is in the complete combined natural classification/rank spectrum, not the PBW premise.
The analysis is self-review; no separate expert or independent audit has been done.

value.rationale: The complete graded-homomorphism classification directly concerns a family whose published structure emphasizes quadratic generators and special Veronese/Segre maps. It yields natural categorical information for all pairs of generator ranks, and an infinite family of distinct graded retracts split precisely into finite square-zero and infinite Yang–Baxter canonical types; the full conjugacy and finite-field multiplicity profiles are then determined. These are structural rather than arbitrarily sliced numerical facts. Scope is limited to graded unital maps and no larger downstream theorem is asserted.
